_about: Dated facts about D&D releases for the Herald chat, checked against D&D Beyond, Wizards of the Coast and news coverage. Update when new books are announced.
facts: Dungeons & Dragons was created by Gary Gygax and Dave Arneson and first published in 1974.

Editions: original D&D (1974), Basic (1977 onward), Advanced D&D (1977 to 1979), AD&D 2nd edition (1989), 3rd edition (2000, revised as 3.5 in 2003), 4th edition (2008), 5th edition (2014), and the revised 2024 core rules (sometimes nicknamed 5.5e), which stay compatible with 5th edition.
The 2024 core rules: the Player's Handbook (September 2024), the Dungeon Master's Guide (November 12, 2024) and the Monster Manual (February 18, 2025).
SRD 5.2, a free version of the 2024 core rules, was released on April 22, 2025 under the Creative Commons CC BY 4.0 license.
Forgotten Realms: Heroes of Faerun came out November 11, 2025, and Eberron: Forge of the Artificer on December 9, 2025.
In 2026 D&D moved to themed seasons: a Season of Horror in spring and a Season of Magic from summer into fall.
Ravenloft: The Horrors Within released June 16, 2026, with horror subclasses, species, backgrounds and Dark Gifts.
Arcana Unleashed (a high-magic sourcebook, with magic items that grow in power alongside characters) and the adventure Arcana Unleashed: Deadfall released September 15, 2026.
Dungeons & Dragons: World of Warcraft, a crossover book with classes from the World of Warcraft game, is scheduled for November 17, 2026.

Announced for 2027: the return of Dark Sun (a desert survival setting ruled by sorcerer-kings) as the Season of Survival, with the books Dark Sun: Blood & Power and Dark Sun: Edge of Oblivion and the Psion class, sold with a mature content label; and new Greyhawk material.
